description: Add a 'Preview' button to components/admin/ArticleEditor.tsx near the Save draft / Publish buttons. Clicking it SAVES the current draft first (reusing the existing draft-save path so drafts.<baseId> reflects the latest edits), THEN opens the preview route (/preview/articles/<baseId>) in a NEW TAB via window.open(url, '_blank'). This guarantees the preview reflects current content. It must work whether or not the article was ever published (it always previews the freshly-saved draft). Depends on FEAT-002 (preview route exists).
steps: In components/admin/ArticleEditor.tsx add a preview handler. It must (a) run the same validation used before save (validate(draft)); if invalid, set errors and do NOT open the tab (a partial draft with no title/body is not useful to preview) — or, if you allow previewing incomplete drafts, at minimum require the fields the preview needs; prefer requiring the same validity as Save to keep behavior predictable and reuse isValid. (b) Save the draft to drafts.<baseIdRef.current> using the SAME path Save draft uses: call getAdminClient().createOrReplace(buildDocument(draft, `drafts.${baseIdRef.current}`)) (or the onSave('draft') path when an onSave handler is provided, mirroring handleSave('draft')). Reuse existing state: set saving state during the operation, surface errors via describeError/setSaveError, and update docStatus/dirty exactly as handleSave('draft') does. Consider factoring the shared draft-write logic so Preview and Save draft do not duplicate it. (c) After the save resolves successfully, open window.open(`/preview/articles/${baseIdRef.current}`, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer').

IMPORTANT popup/window.open sequencing: browsers block window.open that is not in the direct user-gesture call stack (i.e. after an awaited async save the popup may be blocked). Handle this robustly: open the tab synchronously at click time to a lightweight placeholder (e.g. `const w = window.open('', '_blank')`), perform the save, then on success set `w.location.href = '/preview/articles/<baseId>'`; if the save fails, close `w` (w?.close()) and show the error. If window.open returns null (popup blocked), fall back to navigating after save by setting the href only, and surface a small hint that the browser blocked the popup. Keep this logic readable and commented.

Add the Preview button in the Publish panel near the Save draft / Publish buttons (same visual group in the right sidebar). Style it consistently with the existing secondary button (border-hairline ... hover:border-accent). Label it 'Preview'. Disable it while saving !== null or when the draft is invalid (!isValid), matching how Save/Publish are disabled. Add a title/tooltip like 'Saves the draft and opens a live preview in a new tab' so the UX is clear. Show a transient saving label (e.g. 'Opening preview…') on the button while its save is in flight, distinct from the 'draft'/'publish' saving modes (extend the SaveMode-driven saving state or add a dedicated boolean like previewing).

Ensure the preview reflects CURRENT content: because the handler saves drafts.<baseId> before opening, and the preview route (FEAT-002) reads drafts.<baseId> first, the new tab shows exactly what was just saved. Confirm baseIdRef.current is the correct un-prefixed base id in all cases (new article: generated; editing a draft or published doc: doc._id with drafts. stripped) — it already is per the existing editor logic.

Do not alter Save draft / Publish behavior, validation rules, buildDocument, the ET publish-time logic, or TableEditor. The only additions are the preview handler, the shared draft-write helper (if extracted), and the Preview button + its transient state.
acceptance_criteria: A 'Preview' button appears next to Save draft / Publish in the editor's Publish panel.
Clicking Preview saves the current draft to drafts.<baseId> (same write path as Save draft) and then opens /preview/articles/<baseId> in a new browser tab.
The button is disabled while a save is in progress and while the draft is invalid, matching Save/Publish disabled behavior, and shows a transient 'Opening preview…' style label while working.

Popup-blocker-safe: the new tab opens on the click gesture and is redirected to the preview URL after the save resolves; on save failure the tab is closed and an actionable error is shown via the existing save-error UI.
Works for never-published articles (previews the freshly-saved draft) and for previously-published ones (previews the current draft edits).
Save draft, Publish, validation, buildDocument, ET publish-time handling, and TableEditor are unchanged.
verification: Static review: confirm the Preview handler reuses buildDocument + getAdminClient().createOrReplace(drafts.<baseId>) (or onSave('draft')) identically to handleSave('draft'), and that window.open is invoked synchronously at click time with the redirect-after-save pattern.
Static review: confirm the button is disabled on !isValid || saving/previewing, has a tooltip, and does not regress existing Save/Publish disabled logic.
On push, GitHub Actions CI (`npm ci && next build && next lint`) must pass.

Deployed manual test (document for the user): (1) open /admin, edit or create an article, fill required fields; (2) click Preview — a new tab opens showing the article styled exactly like the live /news page, including headings, a table, the featured image, and the FAQ; (3) edit the body, click Preview again — the new tab reflects the latest edits; (4) do all of the above BEFORE ever publishing to confirm unpublished drafts preview; (5) confirm the preview tab is not indexed (noindex) and shows the draft banner.
findings: Added a Preview button to components/admin/ArticleEditor.tsx in the Publish panel, styled as a secondary bordered button (matches Save draft), label 'Preview' with title 'Saves the draft and opens a live preview in a new tab'. Extracted the shared draft-write logic into a writeDraft() useCallback (deps [draft, onSave, buildDocument]) so Save draft and Preview cannot drift; it prefers onSave(draft,'draft') then falls back to getAdminClient().createOrReplace(buildDocument(draft, drafts.<baseId>)) and updates docStatus/dirty/_id exactly like the old draft branch. handleSave('draft') now delegates to writeDraft(); the Publish transaction/ET/buildDocument/validation paths are unchanged. Added a separate `previewing` boolean included in all three buttons' disabled conditions (disabled on !isValid || saving !== null || previewing) so only one write runs at a time; Preview shows 'Opening preview…' while working. Popup-blocker-safe: window.open('', '_blank') is called synchronously on click, then after writeDraft() resolves the tab is redirected via w.location.href = `/preview/articles/${baseIdRef.current}`; on save failure w?.close() and setSaveError(describeError(err)); if w is null (popup blocked) the editor state is kept and a hint is shown via setSaveError. Opened WITHOUT 'noopener' deliberately (commented) because noopener makes some browsers return null so the tab could not be redirected; target is same-origin and AdminAuthGate-protected. Verification: could NOT run next build/lint/tsc under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (no registry) per context.json; validated by static review (no unused imports/vars, valid hooks usage, strict-TS-consistent). CI (npm ci && next build && next lint) is the authoritative gate on push. Only components/admin/ArticleEditor.tsx changed (plus this FEAT file). Preview route /preview/articles/[id] confirmed to exist from FEAT-002 (commit c47b483).
